note: Luminos clarity recolor and bonus sprites. Kirk's read on the v5.38.1 system: the dimensions were hard to tell apart because the color families overlapped — gold appeared in direction-neutral AND intensity-low AND alert-stale; lavender appeared in direction-neutral-complement AND adjacent to intensity. Collapsed into three non-overlapping color identities. Direction is now red green slate-gray. Alert is cyan family (soft cyan stale to electric cyan fresh). Intensity is purple family (pale lavender low to vivid magenta high). Now Kirk's sentence works: the red or green tells you direction, the purple tells you how intense the signal is, and the cyan tells you when something fresh has fired. Plus three bonus sprites — one per pair — visible only when that pair's scalar exceeds 0.6. Low signal six sprites visible. Loaded signal up to nine. Three new keyframes for bonus paths. Coordination doc updated.
